 ORDER

This Court on 06.07.2023 had passed the following order:
"Office objection stands overruled.
Learned High Court Government pleader is directed to accept notice for respondent No.1.
Learned counsel for the petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the petition papers upon learned High Court Government Pleader.
Learned counsel for the petitioner is directed to serve the second respondent - complainant by way of hand summons.
NC: 2023:KHC:24915 Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that matter has been settled between the parties.

Therefore, list the matter on 14.07.2023 at Sri Naveen D.A vs The State Of Karnataka on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175982832/

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner has filed an affidavit of the petitioner that respondent No.2 has refused summons.
Therefore, Registry to print the name of respondent No.2 as served.
3. The challenge is with regard to C.C.No.15227/2016 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 34, 498A, 504, 323 and 354 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

The parties to the lis were before the Family Court in a petition filed by respondent No.2 - complainant, wherein the parties have arrived at a settlement and one such condition towards the settlement of dispute between the parties is the closure of the present proceedings.

The said condition reads as follows:
"The petitioner has agreed to cooperate in closing / quashing the proceedings in C.C.No.15227/2016 pending before 41st ACMM, Bengaluru for the offences punishable under Section 498-A, 323, 504, 354 R/W Section 34 of IPC filed against the respondent, his parents and his other family members."
NC: 2023:KHC:24915 4.

In the light of the settlement arrived at between the parties and the offence being one punishable under Sections 34, 498A, 504, 323 and 354 of the IPC, I deem it appropriate to close the proceedings.
5. For the aforesaid reasons, the following ORDER I. Criminal Petition is disposed.
II. The proceedings in C.C.No.15227/2016 pending on the file of IV Additiional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bangalore City stands quashed qua the petitioners.
